title: Ruby OpenSSL::PKey::EC
notes: The openssl extension that ships with Ruby. Each call wraps the SEC1 point in a fixed SPKI header, parses it with OpenSSL::PKey.read and calls PKey#verify('SHA384', der_signature, message), which hashes the message. prepare (untimed) decodes the hex and turns r||s into the DER signature OpenSSL takes.
